title: Grilled Mozzarella Balls Skewers with Zesty Citrus Glaze
description: A simple and delicious appetizer featuring grilled mozzarella balls on skewers, served with a zesty citrus glaze.

ingredients.name: Wooden skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak in water for 30 minutes before use

instructions: 2. Thread a mozzarella ball onto each skewer.
3. Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
4. Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the cheese is melted and the skewers are lightly charred.
5. In a small bowl, mix together the lemon zest, lemon juice, and garlic clove (if using).
6. Brush the zesty citrus glaze over the grilled skewers.
